description: This file implements WebSocket queue management for the Mattermost platform, including functions for retrieving, marshaling, and unmarshaling WebSocket message queues and dead queues, as well as handling message types and sequence management.

methods.name: GetWSQueues
methods.description: Retrieves WebSocket queues for a user connection, handling active and dead queues based on sequence number.

methods.name: marshalAQ
methods.description: Marshals an active WebSocket message queue into a slice of ActiveQueueItems.

methods.name: UnmarshalAQItem
methods.description: Unmarshals an ActiveQueueItem into a WebSocketMessage.

methods.name: marshalDQ
methods.description: Marshals a dead WebSocket message queue into JSON RawMessages, handling queue rollover.

methods.name: UnmarshalDQ
methods.description: Unmarshals JSON RawMessages into a dead WebSocket message queue and pointer.
